name: The Lost Supplies
summary: A small, sturdy barrel has its seams sealed with pungent yellow wax. A stamp on its base names Quartermaster Lungertz and Nethergarde Keep, and that is where it belongs.

sections.title: A Stamped Barrel
sections.body: Pungent yellow wax seals the seams of this compact, stout barrel. Underneath, a stamp reads Quartermaster Lungertz, Nethergarde Keep, so the barrel is meant for the quartermaster there.

sections.title: Word from the Quartermaster
sections.body: Quartermaster Lungertz thanks you. Supplies go astray all the way from Darkshire to Nethergarde, and it is good to see some recovered.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive the lost supplies?
faq.answer: The barrel is marked for Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.

faq.q: How can you tell who owns the barrel?
faq.answer: The base of the barrel carries a stamp naming Quartermaster Lungertz and Nethergarde Keep.

faq.q: What does the barrel look like?
faq.answer: It is a small, sturdy barrel with pungent yellow wax along its seams.
